question: The position of how many letters will remain unchanged if all the letters in the word MOBILE are arranged in English alphabetical order?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/016785141d4dd4f8894ef5402e0621e98f86e584bb70bac223d82bef408c1256.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e15fad63c6e08705ee54ccb1e20ab79c570d6c7f2da3aff9540161e32ae6a1ab.png] 

Thus, the position of **No **letters will remain unchanged if all the letters in the word MOBILE are arranged in English alphabetical order.
